transactions.desc: The Giants activated Cox (oblique) from the 10-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Sacramento.
The Royals designated Strahm for assignment Tuesday.
The Orioles optioned Hinds to Triple-A Norfolk on Tuesday.
The Orioles optioned Heuer to Triple-A Norfolk on Tuesday.
The Giants selected Leonard's contract from Triple-A Sacramento on Tuesday.
The Orioles recalled Povich from Triple-A Norfolk on Tuesday.
The Orioles recalled Franklin from Triple-A Norfolk on Tuesday.
The Royals designated Velazquez for assignment Tuesday.
The Royals recalled Cuas from Triple-A Omaha on Tuesday.
The Cardinals optioned Mathews to Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday.
The Royals activated Witt (back) from the 10-day injured list Tuesday.
Atlanta released Gomber on Monday.
Hernandez elected free agency Monday.
The Nationals recalled Dion from Triple-A Rochester on Tuesday, Spencer Nusbaum of The Athletic reports.
Atlanta released McCutchen on Monday.
The Angels designated Soler for assignment Tuesday, Francys Romero of BeisbolFR.com reports.
The Cardinals recalled Prieto from Triple-A Memphis on Tuesday, Derrick Goold of the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reports.
The Orioles released Siani on Tuesday, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.
The White Six activated Gilbert (shoulder) from the 15-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Charlotte on Tuesday.
The White Sox optioned Schweitzer to Triple-A Charlotte on Tuesday.
The Reds recalled Petty from Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday.
Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Tuesday on the "Talkin' Yanks" podcast by Jomboy Media that De Los Santos has been recalled from Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre.
The Mets recalled Yan from Triple-A Syracuse on Tuesday, Francys Romero of BeisbolFR.com reports.
The Reds recalled Rodriguez from Triple-A Louisville on Tuesday.
The Marlins activated Ekness (calf) from the 60-day injured list Tuesday, Kevin Barral of FishonFirst.com reports.
The Marlins selected Ralston's contract on Tuesday and optioned him to Triple-A Jacksonville, Kevin Barral of FishonFirst.com reports.
The Marlins optioned Fulton to Triple-A Jacksonville on Tuesday, Kevin Barral of FishonFirst.com reports.
The Angels recalled Johnson from Triple-A Salt Lake on Monday, Jeff Fletcher of The Orange County Register reports.
The San Francisco Giants traded LHP Erik Miller to the Boston Red Sox.
The Tampa Bay Rays traded RHP Jacob Kmatz to the Los Angeles Dodgers.
